logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.

moments.description: The judge officially opens the trial, accusing Lady Juliana of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.
moments.key_dialogue: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.

moments.description: The judge presses Lady Juliana on whether she practices forbidden arts, and she proudly admits to healing the sick.
moments.key_dialogue: I admit to healing the sick.

moments.description: Lady Juliana's former maid Prudence breaks down and gives false testimony under pressure, confirming the alleged rituals.
moments.key_dialogue: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.

moments.description: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the railing in fierce indignation as the judge orders her silenced.
The judge offers Lady Juliana a chance to save herself by renouncing her practices, but she unflinchingly refuses.
moments.key_dialogue: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.

moments.description: Lady Juliana delivers a defiant final speech before the judge raises his hand to pronounce the devastating sentence.
moments.key_dialogue: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.
